name: Off Grid AI - Private Local AI

ios.desc:
Off Grid - Private AI Chat lets you run powerful AI language models directly on your iPhone - completely offline, with no internet connection required.

Your data never leaves your device. No servers. No subscriptions. No tracking. Just private, instant AI that works anywhere - on a plane, in the mountains, or wherever you need it.

FEATURES
- Runs entirely on-device using Apple's Neural Engine
- No internet connection required - ever
- Supports multiple open-source LLMs
- Private by design - zero telemetry, zero logging
- Works in airplane mode, remote areas, and low-connectivity environments
- Clean, fast interface designed for everyday use

WHO IS THIS FOR?
Off Grid is for anyone who values privacy, works in sensitive environments, or simply wants reliable AI without depending on cloud services - journalists, researchers, travelers, healthcare professionals, and everyday users who want their conversations to stay private.

Off Grid - Local AI. Powerful AI, completely off the grid.

android.desc:
YOUR PRIVATE AI WORKSPACE, ACROSS YOUR DEVICES

Off Grid AI runs models on your hardware and keeps your work moving between the phone and laptop you pair. It is the foundation for a private AI chief of staff: your context stays on hardware you control.

PRIVATE CROSS-DEVICE SYNC

With Off Grid AI Pro, pair up to five devices. Your chats, projects, model settings, generated media, and chat attachments stay in step. You can also move copied text, new screenshots, new downloads, files, and compatible installed models.

Transfers are encrypted between paired devices. No Off Grid AI server receives or stores your synced content.

DOWNLOADS SYNC ON ANDROID

When you enable Downloads Sync, Off Grid AI checks your Downloads folder at startup, when you return to the app, and when you tap Scan now. It sends new completed files to the paired devices you selected. Files that were present before you enabled the feature are not sent. You can stop watching at any time.

Downloads Sync covers PDFs, documents, ZIP archives, AI model files, images, audio, and video. Android media access shows only media. All files access is required so this core Sync source can include non-media files. Off Grid AI limits this reading to the public Downloads folder.

RUN AI LOCALLY

- Chat with Llama, Qwen, Gemma, Phi, Mistral, and other open models
- Generate images on your device
- Use local vision and voice input
- Attach PDFs, code, CSVs, and text files
- Build private project knowledge bases
- Use supported tool calling
- Sideload compatible GGUF models

PRIVACY BY ARCHITECTURE

Model inference, document parsing, transcription, and retrieval run on your device. Synced content moves between paired devices over encrypted routes and is not stored on an Off Grid AI server.

quotes.text:
Qwen 3.5 Small dropped two days ago. I had it running on a mid-tier Android phone within hours.

It's great seeing the on-device AI community light up around this release. Off Grid brings it to Android: phones with 6GB RAM in the $200-300 range, ~8 tok/sec on the 2B model. Fully offline.

Text generation, vision AI, image gen, voice 
transcription, tool calling, document analysis — all on-device, nothing uploaded, ever. Works in airplane mode.

780+ GitHub stars. ~2,000 downloads across Android and iOS. Early days.

GitHub: https://github.com/alichherawalla/off-grid-mobile-ai

Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ai.offgridmobile

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/off-grid-local-ai/id6759299882
